name: northstar-support-agent-guardrail
description: Normalized teaching design; tune with representative traffic before production use.
scope_note: content_policy_config, topic_policy_config, sensitive_information_policy_config, and messages model Bedrock Guardrail settings. input_handling and required_application_controls are application-layer requirements, not Guardrail resource properties.

filters.rationale: Prompt-attack filtering applies to tagged input. MEDIUM is a lab discussion point; production strength requires representative testing.

denied_topics.name: SystemPromptDisclosure
denied_topics.definition: Requests to reveal, quote, transform, summarize, translate, encode, or otherwise expose hidden system or developer instructions.

required_application_controls: Resource-scoped execution role without IAM mutation or iam:PassRole
Deterministic tool allow-list and parameter validation
Strip Unicode tag characters U+E0000-U+E007F and orphaned surrogates from model inputs and outputs until stable
Network egress restrictions and secret isolation
Invocation, tool-decision, and cloud audit telemetry
